budget_policy.applies_to: all strategies (fixed, random, evidence, qwen) identically
budget_policy.baseline: 1 LP (maximise biomass); always run first when the menu is non-empty
budget_policy.experiment_limit: config.max_experiments counts every attempted menu item, skipped_budget included
budget_policy.focus_truncation: focus checks run for floor((remaining - product_LPs) / 3) reactions after the growth LP; any shortfall is recorded as focus_checks_truncated_by_budget
budget_policy.no_planner_reserve: no calls are held back for any planner; qwen requests do not consume solver calls
budget_policy.per_experiment_mandatory: 1 growth LP, plus 2 LPs (max and min secretion) for product experiments
budget_policy.per_focus_reaction: 3 LPs (FVA min, FVA max, knockout growth) for up to config.max_focus_reactions reactions of the linked hypotheses that the experiment does not itself knock out
budget_policy.skip_rule: an experiment is skipped (skipped_budget) if remaining calls < its mandatory calls

selection_log.rationale: Tests growth dispensability of G_SCO7221 to establish baseline viability before assessing product synthesis capacity.

Baseline growth is unaffected by the knockout, so growth dispensability does not rule out a secondary metabolism function. Measuring the intracellular synthesis capacity for the primary product (germicidinA) in the wild-type model is the necessary first step to establish if the pathway is active and
Tests if germincidin A synthesis is feasible under the specific condition hint (phosphate removal) associated with evidence E0, distinguishing conditional production from constitutive capacity.
